menu_options.gemini: Google Gemini (AI Studio keys, mostly free)

openrouter.title: Connect OpenRouter
openrouter.description: Enter an OpenRouter API key. It stays on your Home Assistant server and is never shown in the Event Scout page. Set a monthly spending limit on the key in OpenRouter.

gemini.title: Connect Google Gemini
gemini.description: Create keys at aistudio.google.com. Google Search is only available on a project with billing turned on; it includes 5,000 free searches a month, and you pay only for the tokens those searches use (a fraction of a cent each). Optionally add a second key from a free-tier project: it is used for everything except searching, at no cost.

data_description.gemini_search_key: Used only for Google Search calls.
data_description.gemini_key: Used for reading saved sources and scoring. Leave empty to use the search key for everything.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach OpenRouter. Check the connection and try again.
